messages:
maria: @deploy-bot flagged canary p95 > 300ms for embeddings-service, rolling hold engaged. Thoughts?

deploy-bot: AUTO-HOLD triggered at 2026-03-21T14:05Z — route frozen, canary 20% stopped. Reason: latency-regression p95=320ms (+60%).

ben: I see error budget bump in USW2, also a small increase in 502s. Not massive but steady.

sam: Can we do a manual rollback to v2.8.1 while we triage? That version had stable KV hotpath.

maria: I'm leaning manual rollback; deploy-bot auto-lifts after 30m unless manual ack.

ben: Criteria check — 1) p95 > 300ms sustained for 10m, 2) error rate > 0.5%, 3) client complaints in support. We hit 1 and small on 2. Recommend manual pin.

maria: OK — I'll request pin. @sam can you confirm release notes update to mention the KV hotpath revert and customer note draft?

sam: Will update release_notes.md draft. Short blurb: 'Reverting embeddings-service to v2.8.1 due to regression in hotpath with long-context requests.'

ben: I'll execute the manual rollback. Plan: 1) Pin traffic to v2.8.1 for canary, 2) Gradually shift 40% then 100% over 8m, 3) Validate p95 drops and 5xxs normalize.

maria: Also add a temporary safety-throttle: set max_concurrent=2 for long-context requests to prevent overload during rollout. Who applies?

sam: I'll push the throttle config and release note. Deploy command I'll run: `deployctl pin --service=embeddings --version=2.8.1 --scope=canary`

ben: Running rollback now. Pinging when done.

deploy-bot: Manual rollback requested by ben; starting traffic pin to v2.8.1. Canary 40% -> 100% in progress.

maria: :thumbsup: monitor dashboards and log traces. If errors > baseline revert to staged rollback plan.

ben: Canary reached 100% at 14:15Z, p95 now 160ms, 5xxs back to baseline. Rolling forward to full rollout complete.

sam: Release note published to /releases/2026-03-21-embeddings-rollback.md and slack #release-notes pinged.

maria: Thanks team. Closing incident after 30m stable. We'll open a follow-up postmortem to detail root cause.

oncall-bot: Incident closed by maria at 14:45Z. Follow-up PM assigned: @lia.
thread_summary: Canary latency regression triggered deploy-bot auto-hold; team executed manual rollback to v2.8.1, applied temporary safety-throttle, confirmed p95 improvement and normalized errors; release note pushed and incident closed pending postmortem.
